name: ds
description: Directory Service Directory Service is a web service that makes it easy for you to setup and run directories in the Amazon Web Services cloud, or connect your Amazon Web Services resources with an existing self-managed Microsoft Active Directory.

subcommands.name: accept-shared-directory
subcommands.description: Accepts a directory sharing request that was sent from the directory owner account.

subcommands.name: add-ip-routes
subcommands.description: If the DNS server for your self-managed domain uses a publicly addressable IP address, you must add a CIDR address block to correctly route traffic to and from your Microsoft AD on Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: add-region
subcommands.description: Adds two domain controllers in the specified Region for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or overwrites one or more tags for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: cancel-schema-extension
subcommands.description: Cancels an in-progress schema extension to a Microsoft AD directory.

subcommands.name: connect-directory
subcommands.description: Creates an AD Connector to connect to a self-managed directory.

subcommands.name: create-alias
subcommands.description: Creates an alias for a directory and assigns the alias to the directory.

subcommands.name: create-computer
subcommands.description: Creates an Active Directory computer object in the specified directory.

subcommands.name: create-conditional-forwarder
subcommands.description: Creates a conditional forwarder associated with your Amazon Web Services directory.

subcommands.name: create-directory
subcommands.description: Creates a Simple AD directory.

subcommands.name: create-hybrid-ad
subcommands.description: Creates a hybrid directory that connects your self-managed Active Directory (AD) infrastructure and Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: create-log-subscription
subcommands.description: Creates a subscription to forward real-time Directory Service domain controller security logs to the specified Amazon CloudWatch log group in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-microsoft-ad
subcommands.description: Creates a Microsoft AD directory in the Amazon Web Services Cloud.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of a Simple AD or Microsoft AD directory in the Amazon Web Services cloud.

subcommands.name: create-trust
subcommands.description: Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory allows you to configure trust relationships.

subcommands.name: delete-ad-assessment
subcommands.description: Deletes a directory assessment and all associated data.

subcommands.name: delete-conditional-forwarder
subcommands.description: Deletes a conditional forwarder that has been set up for your Amazon Web Services directory.

subcommands.name: delete-directory
subcommands.description: Deletes an Directory Service directory.

subcommands.name: delete-log-subscription
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified log subscription.

subcommands.name: delete-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes a directory snapshot.

subcommands.name: delete-trust
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing trust relationship between your Managed Microsoft AD directory and an external domain.

subcommands.name: deregister-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes from the system the certificate that was registered for secure LDAP or client certificate authentication.

subcommands.name: deregister-event-topic
subcommands.description: Removes the specified directory as a publisher to the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: describe-ad-assessment
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a directory assessment, including its current status, validation results, and configuration details.

subcommands.name: describe-ca-enrollment-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about the certificate authority (CA) enrollment policy for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-certificate
subcommands.description: Displays information about the certificate registered for secure LDAP or client certificate authentication.

subcommands.name: describe-client-authentication-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the type of client authentication for the specified directory, if the type is specified.

subcommands.name: describe-conditional-forwarders
subcommands.description: Obtains information about the conditional forwarders for this account.

subcommands.name: describe-directories
subcommands.description: Obtains information about the directories that belong to this account.

subcommands.name: describe-directory-data-access
subcommands.description: Obtains status of directory data access enablement through the Directory Service Data API for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-controllers
subcommands.description: Provides information about any domain controllers in your directory.

subcommands.name: describe-event-topics
subcommands.description: Obtains information about which Amazon SNS topics receive status messages from the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-hybrid-ad-update
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about update activities for a hybrid directory.

subcommands.name: describe-ldaps-settings
subcommands.description: Describes the status of LDAP security for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-regions
subcommands.description: Provides information about the Regions that are configured for multi-Region replication.

subcommands.name: describe-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the configurable settings for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: describe-shared-directories
subcommands.description: Returns the shared directories in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-snapshots
subcommands.description: Obtains information about the directory snapshots that belong to this account.

subcommands.name: describe-trusts
subcommands.description: Obtains information about the trust relationships for this account.

subcommands.name: describe-update-directory
subcommands.description: Describes the updates of a directory for a particular update type.

subcommands.name: disable-ca-enrollment-policy
subcommands.description: Disables the certificate authority (CA) enrollment policy for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: disable-client-authentication
subcommands.description: Disables alternative client authentication methods for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: disable-directory-data-access
subcommands.description: Deactivates access to directory data via the Directory Service Data API for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: disable-ldaps
subcommands.description: Deactivates LDAP secure calls for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: disable-radius
subcommands.description: Disables multi-factor authentication (MFA) with the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server for an AD Connector or Microsoft AD directory.

subcommands.name: disable-sso
subcommands.description: Disables single-sign on for a directory.

subcommands.name: enable-ca-enrollment-policy
subcommands.description: Enables certificate authority (CA) enrollment policy for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: enable-client-authentication
subcommands.description: Enables alternative client authentication methods for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: enable-directory-data-access
subcommands.description: Enables access to directory data via the Directory Service Data API for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: enable-ldaps
subcommands.description: Activates the switch for the specific directory to always use LDAP secure calls.

subcommands.name: enable-radius
subcommands.description: Enables multi-factor authentication (MFA) with the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server for an AD Connector or Microsoft AD directory.

subcommands.name: enable-sso
subcommands.description: Enables single sign-on for a directory.

subcommands.name: get-directory-limits
subcommands.description: Obtains directory limit information for the current Region.

subcommands.name: get-snapshot-limits
subcommands.description: Obtains the manual snapshot limits for a directory.

subcommands.name: list-ad-assessments
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of directory assessments for the specified directory or all assessments in your account.

subcommands.name: list-certificates
subcommands.description: For the specified directory, lists all the certificates registered for a secure LDAP or client certificate authentication.

subcommands.name: list-ip-routes
subcommands.description: Lists the address blocks that you have added to a directory.

subcommands.name: list-log-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Lists the active log subscriptions for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-schema-extensions
subcommands.description: Lists all schema extensions applied to a Microsoft AD Directory.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags on a directory.

subcommands.name: register-certificate
subcommands.description: Registers a certificate for a secure LDAP or client certificate authentication.

subcommands.name: register-event-topic
subcommands.description: Associates a directory with an Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: reject-shared-directory
subcommands.description: Rejects a directory sharing request that was sent from the directory owner account.

subcommands.name: remove-ip-routes
subcommands.description: Removes IP address blocks from a directory.

subcommands.name: remove-region
subcommands.description: Stops all replication and removes the domain controllers from the specified Region.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a directory.

subcommands.name: reset-user-password
subcommands.description: Resets the password for any user in your Managed Microsoft AD or Simple AD directory.

subcommands.name: restore-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Restores a directory using an existing directory snapshot.

subcommands.name: share-directory
subcommands.description: Shares a specified directory (DirectoryId) in your Amazon Web Services account (directory owner) with another Amazon Web Services account (directory consumer).

subcommands.name: start-ad-assessment
subcommands.description: Initiates a directory assessment to validate your self-managed AD environment for hybrid domain join.

subcommands.name: start-schema-extension
subcommands.description: Applies a schema extension to a Microsoft AD directory.

subcommands.name: unshare-directory
subcommands.description: Stops the directory sharing between the directory owner and consumer accounts.

subcommands.name: update-conditional-forwarder
subcommands.description: Updates a conditional forwarder that has been set up for your Amazon Web Services directory.

subcommands.name: update-directory-setup
subcommands.description: Updates directory configuration for the specified update type.

subcommands.name: update-hybrid-ad
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing hybrid directory.

subcommands.name: update-number-of-domain-controllers
subcommands.description: Adds or removes domain controllers to or from the directory.

subcommands.name: update-radius
subcommands.description: Updates the Remote Authentication Dial In User Service (RADIUS) server information for an AD Connector or Microsoft AD directory.

subcommands.name: update-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the configurable settings for the specified directory.

subcommands.name: update-trust
subcommands.description: Updates the trust that has been set up between your Managed Microsoft AD directory and an self-managed Active Directory.

subcommands.name: verify-trust
subcommands.description: Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory allows you to configure and verify trust relationships.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: hybrid-ad-updated
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query UpdateActivities.SelfManagedInstances[].Status returns Updated for all elements when polling with ``describe-hybrid-ad-update``.
